summary: lineinfile options line (required for present, can contain backreferences) and mode with guidance to quote octal values.
questions: What does the line parameter do in lineinfile?
How should I set permissions with lineinfile?

answer_card.title: lineinfile line and mode
answer_card.answer_md:
- `line` (alias `value`): text to insert/replace; required for `present`; may include backrefs with `backrefs: yes`
- `mode`: quote octal (`'0644'`) or symbolic
